answer_1.quote: Text summarization is an important natural language processing (NLP) task, aiming at generating concise summaries for given texts while preserving the key information.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the quality of predicted summaries by ROUGE scores ... Specifically, ROUGE-n evaluates n-gram overlap between a predicted summary and its reference summary; ROUGE-L, instead, measures the longest common sequence between the predicted and reference summaries.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, we invited three human annotators to compare the two decoding algorithms for NAUS on 50 randomly selected samples ... The annotation was conducted in a pairwise manner in terms of overall quality and fluency/completeness;
